summary: The market exhibits a cautiously optimistic posture with a slight risk-on tilt, as evidenced by the modest 2% of stocks in the Buy tier. Valuations are slightly compressed, with a median fair-value premium of -1.6%, suggesting that stocks may be trading below their intrinsic values. Strength is concentrated in utilities, communication services, and energy sectors, while technology, industrials, and consumer cyclical sectors lag, indicating a rotation towards more defensive plays.
